name: Motion Preferences
summary: The gate every other component in this library reads — one token that resolves to 1 or 0, a page toggle that can only ever add the restriction, and the two different things "reduced motion" can mean once you have more than one knob to turn.
demoNote: The toggle in example 2 controls every example on this page, and the readout under it names the three signals that produced the answer. Example 5 is broken on purpose and live: one extra CSS rule that beats your operating system, with a button that proves it.
